name: Green Neutralizer
desc: A basic alchemical solution. Even novice alchemists can easily synthesize it to test their skills, but it requires precision to extract its full power. Green Neutralizer has an affinity to air.

eff.name: Synthesis: Air Bonus
eff.desc1: Increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1] and quality by [Lv. x 1] when this ingredient and its slot have matching air elements.

eff.name: Element Resonance - Air
eff.desc1: Increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1] when used as an ingredient for an air element synthesized item.
